rules.text: Items can be returned with a receipt within 90 days of purchase for a refund or exchange.
rules.quote: Returns with a Receipt within 90 Days of Purchase

rules.text: Returns with a receipt after 90 days of purchase receive in-store credit only.
rules.quote:
Returns with a Receipt after 90 Days of Purchase

If you make a return after 90 days of purchase, you will receive an in-store credit for the original purchase price.

rules.text: A driver's license or state ID is required for all no-receipt returns.
rules.quote: Please note that a driver's license or state ID will be required for all no-receipt returns.

rules.text: Gas-powered items may be returned or exchanged within 30 days of purchase if unused, in original package, and not filled with gas.
rules.quote: A gas-powered item may be returned or exchanged within 30 days of purchase with a receipt if the item has not been used, is in the original package, and has not been filled with gas.

rules.text: Service items may be returned or exchanged within 30 days of purchase if unused and in original package.
rules.quote: A service item, such as a handheld gas-powered item or contractor paint sprayer, may be returned or exchanged within 30 days of purchase if the item has not been used and is in the original package.

rules.text: Major appliances with manufacturing defects may be returned or exchanged within 7 days of purchase.
rules.quote: A major appliance may be returned or exchanged within 7 days of the purchase date if the item has a manufacturing defect.

rules.text: Major appliances may be returned or exchanged within 90 days of purchase if unused and in original package.
rules.quote: A major appliance can be returned or exchanged within 90 days of the purchase date if the item has not been used and is in the original package.
